title: ImgConvert
description:
ImgConvert is a local-first desktop app for batch image conversion and compression. Add JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, SVG, static GIF, or BMP files or folders, choose JPEG, PNG, WebP, or AVIF output, then adjust quality, true lossless mode, and the destination for the queue. Individual images can override the shared format when needed.

Optional compression policies can keep only smaller outputs or beneficial lossy re-encodes; they are off by default so a requested output format is produced even when it is larger. Supported metadata is preserved only when explicitly enabled. Conversion, thumbnails, queue management, and file writing stay on your device. No account, ads, analytics, or image uploads are required.
